jobs.description:
Are you passionate about fashion, accessories, and creative collaboration?
We are looking for an experienced Senior Accessory Designer to join an innovative fashion team working on exclusive guest designer collaborations. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to creative collections that combine high-fashion aesthetics, innovation, and sustainability.
 
About the Client
Our client is a global leader in fashion and retail, operating in a dynamic and fast-paced environment where business and technology meet. The organization is committed to sustainable growth and innovation, with a focus on leveraging technology to drive transparency and efficiency in financial management.
About the role
You will play an important role in developing accessories from initial ideas to finished products, working closely with product managers, product developers, pattern makers, and external partners.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Designing and developing accessories, jewellery, sunglasses, bags, footwear, and other product categories.
Translating collaboration partners’ ideas into creative designs and complete product collections.
Contributing to collection building and creating designs that strengthen brand identity.
Working with premium materials, components, and product construction.
Following the product development process from concept and sketching to production.
Collaborating with international teams, suppliers, and production offices.
Identifying trends and contributing to innovative and sustainable product development.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a creative, independent, and hands-on designer with a strong fashion sense and a passion for high-end fashion.
To be successful in this role, you should have:
A bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Textile Design, or a related field.
At least 5 years of experience working as a designer, with a strong background in collection development.
Extensive knowledge of accessories, particularly jewellery and sunglasses. Experience with footwear and underwear is an advantage.
Experience working with international fashion brands.
Strong technical knowledge of product development, premium materials, and product details.
Excellent skills in Adobe Creative Suite.
A good understanding of fashion trends, sustainability, and innovation.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
A structured and organised approach, with the ability to prioritise and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
Fluency in English.

What makes this opportunity exciting?
You will work in a creative, fast-moving environment where innovation, collaboration, and design excellence are key. You will have the opportunity to shape distinctive guest designer collections and contribute to products that bring fresh ideas and creativity to the fashion industry.
Interested?
If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please get in touch and share your CV in English.
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Uppsala är en åk 4-9 skola med ca 750 elever och 80 medarbetare. Skolan har en tvåspråkig inriktning, svenska och engelska, där delar av undervisningen i matte, NO och Engelska och några estetiska ämnen sker på engelska. 

Vi söker nu en legitimerad grundskollärare år 4-6 med en ämnesbehörighet och legitimation i Sv/SO.

Ansvarsområden:

- Planera, genomföra och utveckla lektioner
- Bedöma elevens framsteg, ge konstruktiv feedback och föra noggranna dokumentationer
- Mentorskap för elever i en av de klasserna du undervisar
- Samarbeta med kollegor för att skapa en stödjande och inkluderande lärmiljö
- Delta i professionell utveckling och bidra till skolans gemenskap

Vem är du?

- Du har lärarexamen med behörighet och legitimation i Svenska och SO åk 4-6
- Du kan uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.
- Du planerar, genomför och utvärderar undervisningen samt arbetar för att skapa en trygg och stimulerande lärandemiljö.
- Du är en lagspelare och ser ett värde av samarbete inom dina arbetslag och tycker om att arbeta med människor i en internationell skolmiljö.
- Du tar ansvar för att systematiskt dokumentera, analysera, utvärdera och följa upp elevernas kunskapsutveckling.
- Du tar egna initiativ och har ett tydligt ledarskap i klassrummet.
- Du är klar och tydlig i din kommunikation och har förmåga att motivera och entusiasmera elever till att ta till sig ny kunskap.
- Du har goda kunskaper i IKT som pedagogiskt verktyg.
- Du brinner för utveckling och ett kollegialt arbetssätt.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och vi förutsätter att du har ett genuint intresse för barn och ungdomar. Tjänsten är förärldrarvikariat, på heltid från vecka 2 fram till vecka 14. Lön enligt överenskommelse, kollektivavtal finns.

Rekryteringen sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan (CV, personligt brev och lärarlegitimation) via vår IES Careers-webbplats alternativt recruitment.uppsala@engelska.se

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

Dibber etablerades i Sverige 2017 och bedriver idag förskolor, grundskolor, anpassade grundskolor och öppna förskolor. Dibbers huvudkontor ligger i Sollentuna, verksamhet finns i stora delar av Sverige.
Dibber i Sverige är en del av den norska friskolekoncernen Dibber som startades och ägs av två engagerade pedagoger, Randi och Hans Jacob Sundby. Den första förskolan startas 2003 i den lilla stad där Randi växt upp. Idag driver Dibber mer än 600 förskolor i nio länder över hela världen. Vi står upp för livslångt lärande och att hålla oss i framkant inom våra professioner. Vi strävar efter att bygga ett professionellt nätverk där vi lär av varandra och som kan stötta och inspirera. Oavsett vilken del av verksamheten som du arbetar inom, blir du en del av ett team som vill göra en skillnad för barn och elever, och deras framtid. Tillsammans skapar vi en inkluderande arbetsplats präglad av hjärtekultur, lärande och utveckling. 

Välkommen till Dibber – med hjärta för lärande!

jobs.occupation: Loving and Experienced DAYTIME Nanny Wanted for a Wonderful Little Boy
jobs.description:
Ref. 4298Ö
We are looking for a warm, caring and experienced daytime nanny to become an important part of a lovely family in Östermalm. Two nannies will share the position, one covering daytime and one nighttime, working alternate weeks.
The family hopes to find someone with a genuine love for children who can become like an extra mum to their little boy, providing love, security and stability.
The mother has a permanent back injury that limits her ability to lift and physically assist her son. Having a nanny available whenever he is with his mother is therefore essential. The role involves supporting both the child and the family in everyday life.
About the Little Boy
He is a happy, affectionate, confident and energetic 4.5-year-old who loves tennis, football and cars. He enjoys playing, exploring and spending time with an engaged adult.
He attends nursery approximately 09:00–15:00 and is in good health. English is his main language, and the family would ideally like an English-speaking nanny to help maintain and develop his English.
Day Nanny – Responsibilities
The role combines childcare with light household support.
While he is at nursery, approximately 2–5 hours will generally be spent on household tasks. The nanny should remain available in case he is unwell, nursery is closed or plans change.
Responsibilities include:
Morning routines, breakfast and preparing meals and snacks.
Nursery drop-off and collection.
Playing, engaging and supporting his interests and activities.
Preparing healthy meals for the family.
Laundry, ironing and making beds.
Keeping the child's areas tidy and cleaning up after him.
Wiping kitchen surfaces and general light household tasks.
Administering medication when required.

The family particularly appreciates someone who enjoys cooking and takes initiative in the kitchen. A weekly cleaner is employed.
Working Schedule & Flexibility
The position involves 12-hour shifts every other week, averaging approximately 167 hours per month.
Reliability and consistency are essential. Occasional cover for the other nanny may be required in case of sickness. Both nannies are expected to work as a supportive team.
International Travel
The family travels internationally throughout the year, sometimes for 1–2 weeks or longer, and the nanny must be happy to accompany them.
During trips, extended working hours may be required, with time off in lieu afterwards. Both nannies may occasionally cover daytime and nighttime duties.
The family also has a second home abroad. A driving licence is not essential but would be an advantage.
The Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who is:
Warm, loving, empathetic and passionate about children.
Experienced with young children.
Energetic, playful, calm and patient.
Emotionally intelligent and confident setting loving boundaries.
Reliable, responsible and trustworthy.
Flexible, proactive and helpful.
Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
Happy to travel internationally.
English- or Swedish-speaking.
Comfortable administering medication when required.
Enjoys cooking and preparing family meals.

A Special Long-Term Opportunity
This is an opportunity to become a valued and trusted part of a warm family, building a close and lasting relationship with their little boy.
The family is looking for someone who genuinely cares about his happiness and development and brings warmth, stability and positive energy into his everyday life.
If you are an experienced, caring and dependable nanny who would love to become part of this family, we would love to hear from you!
Location: Östermalm, Stockholm
Start date: November 2026 – January 2027 (TBC)
Schedule: Every other week
Working hours: 08:00–20:00 (±1 hour)
Child: One boy, 4.5 years old
Languages: English preferred
Position: Long-term, full-time employment

Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningsperioden.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Engineer  BEV Chassis Integration
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Design Engineer – BEV Chassis Integration | CATIA V5
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Mechanical Design Engineer – BEV Chassis Integration
Specialisation: Mechanical Design | Chassis Integration | Sheet Metal Design | Pneumatic Systems | CATIA V5
Experience: 3+ years of relevant experience
Location: Södertälje, Sweden
Work Model: On-site (100%)
Assignment Period: 1 December 2026 – 29 December 2028
Language: English
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to contribute to the development and integration of components and systems for Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) chassis solutions.
You will work on mechanical design, component integration and installation solutions within heavy-duty vehicle platforms, with a particular focus on sheet metal components, brackets, pneumatic systems and chassis packaging.
The role involves working with advanced CAD tools, developing detailed 3D and 2D designs, coordinating with suppliers and collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver technically robust and production-ready solutions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Mechanical Design & Component Development
Design and develop mechanical components and installation solutions for BEV chassis applications.
Develop sheet metal components, brackets and mounting solutions.
Design and integrate pneumatic components and installation systems.
Create detailed 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V5.
Ensure designs comply with applicable engineering standards and technical requirements.
Perform tolerance analysis and ensure dimensional accuracy.

2. Chassis Integration & Component Packaging
Work with component packaging, interfaces and installation requirements.
Ensure effective integration of mechanical and pneumatic components within vehicle chassis architectures.
Evaluate installation space, clearances, interfaces and mounting requirements.
Develop practical design solutions considering functionality, manufacturability and serviceability.
Support the integration of components within electric vehicle chassis platforms.

3. Supplier & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the design and development lifecycle.
Participate in technical discussions, design reviews and engineering coordination activities.
Support supplier interactions and resolve technical design-related challenges.
Coordinate design requirements and ensure alignment across relevant stakeholders.

4. Verification, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Support design reviews, validation activities and technical investigations.
Prepare and maintain engineering drawings, specifications and technical documentation.
Support manufacturing and production-related activities when required.
Contribute to design optimization, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
Minimum 3 years of relevant mechanical design engineering experience.
Previous R&D experience with Scania/Hero or the relevant TRATON organization is mandatory.
Strong practical experience in one or more of the following areas:
Sheet metal design and development.
Brackets and mechanical installation solutions.
Pneumatic components and installation systems.
Component packaging and chassis integration.
Proficiency in CATIA V5, including 3D modelling and 2D engineering drawings.
Experience with tolerance analysis and dimensional engineering.
Good understanding of component interfaces, packaging and installation requirements.
Knowledge of design for manufacturing and manufacturability principles, particularly for sheet metal, plastic and/or pneumatic components.
Ability to develop practical and technically sound mechanical design solutions.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience
Experience in the following areas will be highly advantageous:
Heavy-duty vehicle chassis design and integration.
Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) development.
Truck chassis component integration and installation.
Sheet metal component design and manufacturing.
Pneumatic system design and integration.
Supplier coordination and technical design reviews.
Vehicle packaging, mounting interfaces and tolerance management.
Production support and engineering documentation.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a proactive and technically capable Mechanical Design Engineer who can independently drive design activities and contribute to complex vehicle integration projects.
The ideal candidate should have practical experience in heavy-duty vehicle development, strong CATIA V5 capabilities and a solid understanding of mechanical design principles.
You should be comfortable collaborating with suppliers, engineering teams and other stakeholders while taking ownership of technical deliverables, solving design challenges and sharing knowledge with colleagues.
Important Information
Previous R&D experience with the specified heavy-duty vehicle OEM/group is mandatory.
The position is 100% on-site in Södertälje.
CV must be submitted in English.
A background check will be conducted before the start of the employment/assignment.
Candidate selection will take place continuously.
There may be opportunities for an extension beyond the stated period.

Are you an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with CATIA V5 expertise and a background in heavy-duty vehicle development?
We would be happy to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Are you our new team member?
Our Fleet Department is growing! We are looking for Mates and Masters who want to be part of a close-knit team on board our survey vessels, delivering survey operations across Europe.
About us:
Njord Survey was founded in 2015 with a clear ambition: to challenge how offshore surveys are delivered. By combining state-of-the-art technology with innovative thinking, we deliver high-quality hydrographic and geophysical surveys more efficiently, for navigation, dredging, charting, marine construction for renewable energy and more.
We are in an exciting phase of growth, now with more than 120 dedicated employees delivering tailored solutions to meet each project’s and client’s needs.
Scope of work:
At Njord Survey, we use state-of-the-art technology to operate efficient survey vessels with a lower environmental footprint. Our vessels typically carry a crew of 2 to 8 people, depending on vessel size and project, which allows us to stay flexible and adapt quickly to our clients’ needs. Data is collected on board and processed by our onshore team at the Gothenburg office.
On board, we work as one team. The vessel operates independently in planning and executing survey operations, in close collaboration with the office and our onshore processing team. Together, the crew is responsible for the safe navigation, operation and maintenance of the vessel, including onboard planning, procurement, inventory and reporting to project management. On some vessels there is no dedicated engineer, so everyone contributes where needed. We are constantly developing how we operate, and your experience and ideas are part of that.
Masters carry overall responsibility for the vessel, crew and safety, while Mates support the Master and take operational responsibility during assigned watches. Both work closely with the survey team on board to ensure high-quality data acquisition.
Learn more about what it's like to work at Njord Survey from our colleague Axel here!
Who we are looking for:
You thrive in small teams and understand that it is the team that makes the vessel work. You enjoy new challenges, are comfortable adapting when plans change, and are always ready to lend a hand where it is needed. You have an interest in technology, and experience from smaller vessels is an advantage.
The organisational language is English, so you need professional proficiency in both spoken and written English.
Requirements and merits:

For applicants applying as Master:

Requirements:

EU/EEA citizenship and residency in Sweden

B driving licence

Medical certificate, ENG1 or equivalent

Basic safety STCW

Restricted Operator’s Certificate (ROC)

Medical Care STCW VI/4.2

Deck Officer Class I (Master Mariner), or RYA/MCA and/or M200GT

Electronic Chart Display and Information System (ECDIS)

Merits:

General Operator’s Certificate (GOC)

For applicants applying as Mate:

Requirements:

EU/EEA citizenship and residency in Sweden

B driving licence

Medical certificate, ENG1 or equivalent

Basic safety STCW

Restricted Operator’s Certificate (ROC)

Deck Officer Class V / VI or M200GT or RYA/MCA Master of yacht Limited

Electronic Chart Display and Information System (ECDIS)

Merits:

General Operator’s Certificate (GOC)

Location: Offshore
Working time: 2 weeks of work followed by 4 weeks off from work, with 12-hours workdays
Our offers to you:
We offer a workplace for you to grow and to stay. At Njord Survey you become part of an experienced team who have fun together and build on each other’s ideas. We invest in our personnel and believe that competence development should be a combination of gained experience from diverse projects together with courses, workshops and activities.
We offer a wide range of employee benefits such as a wellness benefit of 5000 SEK/year, private medical insurance, access to our personnel benefit’s portal, team activities and more.
Our recruitment process:
The recruitment process consists of several evaluation steps to ensure a qualitative process. First a phone interview for us to learn more about your ambitions and for you to get to know Njord Survey and our offers better, followed by online tests and a competence-based interview with the department manager. The aim of the process is for you to learn about the content of the role and for us to evaluate if you have the right profile for the position. You can read more about our recruitment process at the career page here.
Feel free to hand in your application in Swedish or English.
The application will be open until the 15th of November 2026
Candidate selection is ongoing, please hand in your application as soon as possible.
We are looking forward reading your application!
We kindly ask to not be contacted for external recruitment services.
The company is covered by the collective agreement Utveckling & Tjänster. A local trade union representing Sveriges Ingenjörer/Saco can be contacted at saco@njordsurvey.se.

Reports to: Facilities and Operations Manager 
Stockholm International School is a non-profit foundation that caters to the Stockholm Diplomatic community, government, banks and industry. 
Therefore, the security aspect is very important. The Security Officer is responsible for the protection of the students as well as the protection of the staff, visitors and facilities. 
Our vision
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.

Description/Purpose: 
Provide close protection for all staff and students at all times during the school day 
In charge of entrance security at drop-off and pick-up 
Patrol of the grounds and buildings 
Keep all buildings safe and secure from intruders and threats 
Accompany staff and students on field trips, museums, sports days and other special events
Escort students between school buildings 
Engage in weekly meetings with the Security Team to discuss current security issues and threats 
Overview all locations on CCTV 

Preferred Education and Experience:
Proficiency in spoken and written English and Swedish
Training in security or close protection.

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.
What we offer:
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation. 
Contract:
Temporary Contract - Spring Term
Time allocation:  100%
Starting: January 7, 2027
Ending: June 15, 2027
Salary:
Individually negotiated
Application:
Last day for application:  November 30th, 2026
We only accept applications in English and from certified candidates. 
SIS reserves the right to offer the position as soon as a viable candidate is found. 
Please send your letter of interest and CV to application@intsch.se. Please write “Security Officer” in the Subject Line.

Specialpedagog (vikariat)

Vi söker nu en engagerad och drivande specialpedagog för ett vikariat. Du tror att varje elev kan och har möjlighet att nå sin fulla potential, och du hjälper gärna lärare att skapa förutsättningar för differentiering och individuella anpassningar där det behövs. Du brinner för alla elevers rätt att lära och är intresserad av att ta del av den senaste forskningen kring lärande samt bidra till att implementera den i verksamheten.

Hos oss får du arbeta i en dynamisk och multikulturell miljö med kollegor från hela världen.

Vem är du?

- Du är utbildad specialpedagog med erfarenhet av att arbeta i grundskolan, gärna på mellan- och högstadiet
- Du är flytande i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska
- Du har kunskap om och delar Internationella Engelska Skolans värderingar och ethos
- Du brinner för skolutveckling och ett kollegialt arbetssätt

I arbetsuppgifterna ingår att:

- Kartlägga och utreda elevers behov av särskilt stöd
- Upprätta åtgärdsprogram baserat på utredningarna
- Ansvara för kontakter kring elever med externa aktörer (t.ex. BUP, habiliteringen och socialtjänsten)
- Handleda lärare i specialpedagogik
- Delta i elevhälsans arbete för alla elevers bästa

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och förutsätter att du har ett genuint intresse för barn och ungdomar. Hos oss är studiero viktigt, vilket kräver att du är trygg i din roll och har förmågan att skapa ett gott arbetsklimat för både elever och kollegor.

Du är en lagspelare med hög arbetsmoral som trivs i en internationell skolmiljö. Vidare har du god förmåga att kommunicera och samverka med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare, samt en vilja att vara med och utveckla vår skola.

Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 100 % med start så snart som möjligt och pågår till och med den 28 januari. Lön enligt överenskommelse, kollektivavtal finns.

Rekryteringen sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan (CV, personligt brev och examensbevis) via vår IES Careers-webbplats så snart som möjligt, dock senast 30 november 2026.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

This position is offered as a full-time position which requires flexible working hours. In order to cover the full sports calendar, you work in a shift system in which you work five days out of seven; this regularly includes public holidays and weekends.
This role falls under our hybrid working model, where you will work both from home and in the office. When working from the office, you will work from a modern office in the heart of Sliema with spectacular sea views and nearby flat rocky beaches with a variety of outdoor activities. From your first day you will receive training from instructors who will support, guide, and mentor you, so can provide an excellent customer experience.

Complete relocation package (more information below)

Enhancement to the basic salary which is dependent to working days and hours
Life & Health insurance
Gym Membership

Hybrid Working Model

6 weeks of company-provided accommodation upon arrival
Reimbursed flight ticket of up €285
Monthly accommodation allowance of €800 paid out the first six months
€100 added to your monthly salary for the first six months for flights to visit your friends and family back home

 
What you will be doing?
In this role, you will work within our dynamic and multicultural work environment. You will deal with different topics; among other things, you will respond to betting, payment, verification, and general account inquiries. Tasked with supporting our customers via live chat, email, and phone, they play a central role in the customer's bet365 experience.
Providing support to our customer base via Live Chat and email

Liaising with other internal teams to review queries from customers regarding several topics including payments, technical issues, verification, or betting queries

·        Fluent knowledge of spoken and written Danish is essential
·        Good written and spoken English is required
·        Passion for delivering outstanding customer service

·        Willingness to work any five days from seven including weekends

Then send in your application in English today and we will contact you shortly!

Job Description

IKEA of Sweden AB is looking for a legal counsel IT/Digital.  
IKEA of Sweden AB is the company in the Inter IKEA Group that has the assignment to determine and develop the entire IKEA product range, including the IKEA range of connected products. Each year 2,000 new products are introduced within the total range of almost 10,000 products. 
You will provide business-minded legal advice and manage legal matters across IT and digital. Your responsibilities will include supporting smart home product development, negotiating and drafting agreements, participating in IT sourcing activities, and helping the business meet digital compliance requirements, including those under the EU AI Act, NIS2 and GDPR.  
You will belong to the Legal & Governance function at IKEA of Sweden AB and report to the General Counsel and Head of Legal & Governance, Range.  
The person we are looking for is a nice person! It is a goal-oriented, curious, and eager to learn the type of person and a genuine team player. You will get the chance to impact the IKEA success story through your day-to-day work. Our organization requires and values great self-discipline and a natural talent to make things happen, create relationships, and co-operate with people from different backgrounds. You are fluent in English (Swedish is a bonus).  
We offer a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where we both give and take responsibility. You will have the chance to grow with us professionally and individually. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with and support stakeholders and colleagues as well as share your knowledge with people in a global and dynamic context. 
We want you to have: 

A Degree of Master of Laws from a reputable University. 

At least 7 years of relevant professional experience from a business law firm and/or as an in-house legal counsel in an international legal or business environment. 

Experience within the fields of IT and digital compliance with connected agreements. Preferably also experience working with connected products.  

The position is placed in Älmhult (Hybrid) 

Additional Information

What values and strengths will come through in your everyday work?
